articles.headline: World Cup Daily live: Spain thrash Austria; Ronaldo, Portugal face Croatia
articles.description: Follow live for the latest analysis, reaction and news as the FIFA World Cup round of 32 continues.

articles.headline: Mohamed Salah recovers from hamstring for Egypt-Australia
articles.description: Mohamed Salah looks set to feature for Egypt in their round of 32 clash with Australia on Friday after recovering from a hamstring strain, but coach Hossam Hassan would not commit to starting the superstar attacker.

articles.headline: Oyarzabal's brace leads Spain past Austria, into Round of 16
articles.description: Mikel Oyarzabal scores twice as Spain thrash Austria 3-0 to reach the Round of 16, where they'll face either Portugal or Croatia.

articles.headline: Spain finally have World Cup mojo back with first knockout win since 2010 final
articles.description: Heading into the World Cup, Spain's record since their 2010 triumph was three tournaments, zero knockout wins. But after beating Austria 3-0, they're back in business.

articles.headline: UEFA won't send off players who cover mouth when addressing an opponent
articles.description: Players will not be sent off for covering their mouths when speaking to an opponent in UEFA competitions, the governing body confirmed.

articles.headline: McManaman: Victory vs. Austria was Spain's best performance of the World Cup
